title: Miss Douce said yes
html_source:
Douce and Kennedy are often close together in this episode. The term fugue derives for the latin for chase of flee- fuga. Their words are chasing each other.

Chase.

Flee.

d, Miss Douce's head by Miss Kennedy's head, over the 1922#246crossblind of the Ormond bar heard the viceregal hoofs go by, ringing steel. 

 — Is that her? asked Miss Kennedy.
anchor.suffix:
, sitting with his ex, pearl grey and eau de Nil. 

 — Exquisite contrast, Miss Kennedy said. 

 When all agog Miss Douce said eagerly: 

 — Look at the fellow in the tall silk.
